profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: TikTok usernames (with or without @) or profile URLs, e.g. apifytech or https://www.tiktok.com/@nasa. One per line.

profileScrapeSections.title: Profile sections
profileScrapeSections.description: Which lists to scrape from each profile: the videos the creator posted, and/or the videos they reposted.

profileSorting.title: Sort videos
profileSorting.description: Order of the profile's videos, like the Latest / Popular / Oldest tabs on TikTok.

resultsPerPage.title: Videos per profile
resultsPerPage.description: Maximum number of videos to save from each profile (per section).

excludePinnedPosts.title: Exclude pinned videos
excludePinnedPosts.description: Skip the videos pinned to the top of the profile.

oldestPostDateUnified.title: Videos published after
oldestPostDateUnified.description: Only videos published on or after this date: 2025-01-31 or a relative time like "30 days". With "Latest" sorting the scraper stops paging once it passes this date. Leave empty for no limit.

newestPostDate.title: Videos published before
newestPostDate.description: Only videos published on or before this date (2025-12-31 includes the whole day) or a relative time like "7 days". Leave empty for no limit.

leastDiggs.title: Minimum likes
leastDiggs.description: Only videos with at least this many likes (hearts). 0 = no minimum. Skipped videos are free.

mostDiggs.title: Maximum likes
mostDiggs.description: Only videos with at most this many likes. 0 = no maximum.

maxItems.title: Maximum videos per run
maxItems.description: Stop after this many videos in total across all profiles. 0 = no limit (the run still stops at your Maximum cost per run).

shouldDownloadVideos.title: Download videos
shouldDownloadVideos.description: Paid add-on: store each video's MP4 in the key-value store. videoMeta.downloadAddr and mediaUrls then point to the stored copy; the TikTok link stays in videoMeta.originalDownloadAddr.

shouldDownloadCovers.title: Download covers
shouldDownloadCovers.description: Paid add-on: store each video's cover image. videoMeta.coverUrl points to the copy; videoMeta.originalCoverUrl keeps the TikTok link.

shouldDownloadSubtitles.title: Download subtitles
shouldDownloadSubtitles.description: Paid add-on: store every subtitle track (WebVTT). subtitleLinks[].downloadLink points to the copy; tiktokLink keeps the TikTok link.

shouldDownloadSlideshowImages.title: Download slideshow images
shouldDownloadSlideshowImages.description: Paid add-on: store every image of photo slideshows (slideshowImageLinks[].downloadLink).

shouldDownloadAvatars.title: Download avatars
shouldDownloadAvatars.description: Paid add-on: store each creator's avatar once per run (authorMeta.avatar; authorMeta.originalAvatarUrl keeps the TikTok link).

shouldDownloadMusicCovers.title: Download music covers
shouldDownloadMusicCovers.description: Paid add-on: store each sound's cover image (musicMeta.coverMediumUrl; originalCoverMediumUrl keeps the TikTok link).

videoKvStoreIdOrName.title: Key-value store for downloads
videoKvStoreIdOrName.description: Name or ID of the key-value store for downloaded files. Leave empty to use the run's default store (named stores are kept after the run).

fallbackWhenListBlocked.title: Public fallback when the video list is refused
fallbackWhenListBlocked.description: TikTok sometimes refuses a profile's full video list to logged-out visitors. When that happens on every route, collect what the profile still shows publicly: its latest posts and its playlists (marked with dataSource).

proxyCountryCode.title: Proxy country
proxyCountryCode.description: Optional 2-letter country code (e.g. US, GB, DE) for the RESIDENTIAL proxy used for video lists. Leave empty for any country.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Leave as is: profile pages work without a proxy, and video lists switch to Apify RESIDENTIAL automatically when TikTok refuses them. Videos listed through RESIDENTIAL add the "Residential video" extra.

proxyFallback.title: Automatic proxy fallback
proxyFallback.description: Switch routes automatically (Apify RESIDENTIAL and datacenter) when TikTok refuses the current one.
